decision.observation: Inside the wrecked cabin: blue plane seats, a green lizard/crocodile resting on one seat, and a broken opening in the fuselage to the right revealing brown ground. The hunger bar shows an orange depleted section.

decision.memory: Cabin exit at right through the hull gap. Food sources: flatfish on the beach.
